headline: Qantas Flags Fare Increases and Flight Cuts on Rising Fuel Costs
summary: Qantas warned of upcoming fare increases and flight reductions due to surging fuel prices driven by ongoing conflicts in the Middle East.
why: Airlines face severe margin compression from rising jet fuel prices, requiring capacity adjustments and ticket price hikes to offset operational costs.

impacts.name: Qantas Airways
impacts.why: Surging fuel costs prompt flight cuts and fare hikes to protect margins.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: High fuel prices driven by Middle East conflict weighed heavily on operations, forcing the airline to cut flights and raise fares.
